quote: For each test image, we go through the memory, apply the corresponding filter and encoder of each word to the input embedding, and picked the top 3 words with the shortest mean squared error (MSE) between the learned word representation and image embedding.

We evaluate whether its corresponding color, material, shape, or all three of them are among the top 3 selected words... the multiple choice embedding with the smallest MSE is chosen to be the desired attribute composition imagination.
